rows.what the ink shows: A compressed nearly horizontal prefix is followed by a tall descending f-like stroke whose upward diagonal goes directly into a small raised terminal t/hook. There is no separate low o loop or r/m shoulder group after this f and before the raised ending; the next detached looped f starts fermée. The compressed prefix makes the exact abbreviation medium confidence, but the longer uniformt expands unwritten intervening letters.

The glyph above the end of the measure line has a long left upright/descender and a single rounded upper hook bending over to its right, with a pale interior. It does not have the angular up-right shoulder and short right return visible in the neighboring mu-A. A heavy horizontal crossing cuts its lower body, so the lower closure and deletion scope are partly obscured; the surviving upper oval/hook favors rho.

Under the long cancellation stroke, the left stem descends well below the line and rises diagonally to a pointed right shoulder, whose short downstroke remains above the cancellation. To its lower right an A has two slanting legs and a horizontal crossbar. These surviving separate components support mu with subscript A.

The dark main letter has a deep left downstroke, a narrow upward diagonal, and a short rounded right return at the top; it is not the single low bowl of nu. The detached lower-right f has a vertical descender, a small crossbar and a hooked foot.

Inside the pairing, a long thick left stem connects diagonally to a short peaked right shoulder, giving the forked mu shape. The lower-right f is separately visible with upper hook, crossing bar and left-turned lower foot.

The letter before the colon has a left stem extending below its up-right connecting diagonal and a short descending right shoulder. A separate lower A has an open triangular counter and visible crossbar. The left descender excludes a simple nu-shaped trough.

In equation (1), the first letter has a long sloping left descent and an ascending diagonal ending in a narrow looped right shoulder with a short return. The A is smaller and lower to the right, with two legs joined by a crossbar.

The deleted symbol has a small two-lobed bowl above the horizontal cancellation and a distinct stem descending well below it. The bowl survives on both sides of the stem; a T would not supply those curved upper lobes.

After the compressed low initial run, the f rises to a sharp upper turn and drops deeply below the marginal baseline. A small raised angular t follows immediately. There is no intervening low o loop or r/m group between f and the raised terminal. The larger loop farther right belongs to the original horizontal text crossing the margin line.

The cancellation leaves an initial i-dot and a small following loop, low middle returns, a tall narrow descending f-like stroke near the right, and a short accent above the ending. The heavy horizontal stroke merges the intervening bodies, so the entire sequence identifiée is not securely recoverable from the remaining strokes.

Immediately before the surviving (A), a small upper peak and a short lower return protrude from the cancellation. The central connected bodies are merged into the strikeout; neither a complete initial d loop/ascender nor the final letter sequence can be distinguished.

The measure glyph has a long left leg descending below the upper writing level, then retraces upward to a short right shoulder/return. It is not a simple open v-shaped pair of arms. A separate lower-right A has two upright sides and a short crossbar.

The sigma has a clear small oval left body and a horizontal upper-right stroke, followed by (A). A dense vertical smear occupies the superscript position and touches the sigma ending. Enlargement and contrast show no separable crossed star arms; the smear also prevents establishing that the position was blank.

The unstruck symbol has a broad curved bowl, open at the upper left and closing into a small right loop, with a long stem descending from the bowl junction. These curved bowl strokes distinguish it from the straight cap and stem of T.

A looped tall L runs into a long foot; the next word has low initial humps, a tall joined t/h-like rise and a flattened following run. The last word has low initial strokes, a long joining stroke and a raised terminal t with short cross-stroke and small final turn. The words remain separated before the distinct following que. The small internal letters and accent are compressed, limiting confidence.
The isolated character has a rounded upper horizontal, diagonal return down-left and short heavy lower horizontal: a clear z. It is separate from the much darker compressed glyph to its left.

The left stroke extends below the point where the right arch joins it; the right component rises to a rounded crest and returns down. This descending left stem plus right arch is mu, rather than a single nu valley. The lower-right A has two legs and a clear crossbar.

Inside the crossing strokes, z has its own upper hook and diagonal return, n stands clearly above it, and a comma descends before a mu with a long left stem and raised right arm. A is lower-right with a visible crossbar. The large left angle and right arrow-like endpoint belong to or merge with a long cancellation stroke; neither enclosing angle delimiter is independently recoverable.

After the looped d, the measure character descends steeply below the join, returns upward into a separate right arch, and ends in a short downward hook. That long left descender and second raised arm distinguish mu from nu. A is visibly smaller and set lower-right.

The canceled cluster preserves a right upright and a small triangular white counter with a transverse bar, compatible with A. Several heavy diagonal and horizontal cancellation strokes merge with the left leg and apex, preventing secure separation of the underlying letter.

The symbol has an unambiguous left vertical extending below the joined baseline, a short rising right arm and its downward terminal. This is a mu structure rather than the single trough of nu. The following lower-right A has an open triangular apex and broad crossbar.
